primary_vapor_pressure.use: primary p_sat correlation in liquid Ag range

cross_check_vapor_pressure.source: NIST Chemistry WebBook SRD 69, Silver Antoine parameters, reference Hartmann & Schneider (1929)
cross_check_vapor_pressure.use: independent comparison only; discrepancy with Wang fit is temperature dependent; do not average fits blindly

hertz_knudsen_langstrom.sign_convention: signed net flux is positive for evaporation when p_sat>p_Ag_v; if only evaporation is modeled, clip negative flux to zero only as an explicitly one-way boundary assumption. If condensation is relevant, retain signed flux.

alpha_ev.meaning: Table 8 effective volatile coefficient = experimentally extrapolated maximum evaporation rate / theoretical maximum rate under vacuum-distillation conditions
alpha_ev.above_1773K: No measured alpha(T) supplied. Do not extrapolate as validated. Use bracketed sensitivity scenarios 0.0834, 0.1428, 0.2715 only if clearly labelled exploratory.

vaporization_enthalpy.status: derived from vapor-pressure slope under ideal-vapor Clausius-Clapeyron approximation; not direct calorimetry
vaporization_enthalpy.double_counting_warning: If explicit vapor mass/enthalpy transport is included in the conservative total-energy equation, do not also subtract q_ev separately. If only condensed-phase enthalpy is solved, include the surface latent-heat sink consistently.

pressure_data_scope.table5_table7_pressure: total furnace/system pressure in an argon-controlled vacuum distillation experiment, not local Ag vapor partial pressure
pressure_data_scope.p_Ag_v: must be an explicit local Ag vapor partial-pressure input or be solved by a gas kinetic/species model; p_Ag_v=0 is only a free-evaporation upper-bound scenario

recoil_pressure.status: NOT INCLUDED IN P1P; P1Q remains frozen
recoil_pressure.warning: Do not automatically set p_rec=0.54*p_sat or p_rec=j_mass*sqrt(pi*R_specific*T/2). Select a closure only after defining gas rarefaction, backscatter/condensation, and momentum-flux boundary conditions.
